Property: MM-10 · Bug: host start link exposed to students
Priority: High — ship independently of this project, this week
Project: Production Bugs
Phase: Phase 0 · Hotfix (do not wait for the rest of this rollout)
Description:
getBookingRecordings (GET /student/mentor-slots/bookings/:bookingId/recordings) and getStudentBookings (GET /student/mentor-slots/my) return the whole booking row via a plain select() with no field whitelist, including zoomStartUrl (the Zoom HOST start link — lets the holder start/control the meeting as if they were the mentor) and zoomPassword.
Found while scoping the Mentorship Monitoring work, confirmed by a fresh code audit to be broader than first thought. Fix ALL of these, not just the first two:
1. GET /student/mentor-slots/bookings/:bookingId/recordings → getBookingRecordings (mentor-slot.service.ts) — also leaks the full recording row (s3_bucket, s3_key, local file paths) alongside the booking.
2. GET /student/mentor-slots/my → getStudentBookings (mentor-slot.service.ts).
3. The legacy /mentor-slots controller duplicates both of the above via the same two service methods.
4. GET /mentor-sessions/my and GET /student/mentor-sessions/my → getStudentSessions (session.service.ts) — selects the full booking object with no whitelist.
5. getSessionDetail (session.service.ts) — spreads ...session with no whitelist.
Introduce one shared whitelist/DTO for 'booking as seen by a student' and reuse it across all five call sites instead of patching each ad hoc.
Acceptance Criteria:
• None of the 5 call sites above return zoomStartUrl, zoomPassword, or raw storage paths (s3_bucket/s3_key/local paths) to a student.
• Existing student-facing screens (join meeting, view booking, feedback) keep working — the whitelist must still include meetingLink, times, status, names, ratings, feedback.
• A regression test exists asserting these fields are absent from each of the 5 responses.
Verification Notes (fresh audit, Oct 26: CONFIRMED TRUE and materially worse than the original ticket scoped: the audit found 5 leak points across 3 controllers (not 2), including the legacy /mentor-slots duplicate routes and the /mentor-sessions endpoints backed by session.service.ts. This is a live, exploitable production bug today — any student can retrieve the Zoom host-start link for their own booking. Recommend treating this as a standalone hotfix shipped this week regardless of whether/when the rest of this PRD lands; bumped estimate from 0.5 to 1.5 days to reflect the real number of call sites and the value of a single shared whitelist instead of five ad hoc patches. Added as a decision item to MM-23 in case leadership wants to explicitly sequence it.
